fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Sibyl, Civil and the Language of Rule", "body": "Chance frames the night around a letter swap: with the common b to v switch, Sibyl becomes civil and civilization, and Sibyl sits beside kyber and cyber, the root he links to govern and the steersman of a ship. He asks listeners to keep the law in mind, proposing that these prophetesses may sit behind the religious, ecclesiastical and legal framework of feudal and neo feudal societies. Late in the night Dylan extends the chain with Sefer, super, sovereign, cover and caper, and closes on rove, saying that if there is one thing this system does, it roves all over the world."}, {"title": "A Savior Who Returns in Cycles", "body": "Chance argues that wherever the Sibyls appear, their central message is the prophecy of a savior born of a virgin, which the later church fathers attached to Jesus but which he reads as an older system of cyclical reincarnation. Reading Godfrey Higgins, he presents a 600 year cycle, the Neros, and treats Cyrus of Persia as a lawgiving type of Christ. He then walks through the acrostic in the Sibylline Oracles, whose line initials spell Jesus Christ, Son of God, Savior, and argues that an early circular ichthys symbol matches the Dharma wheel."}, {"title": "Dylan on Italy's Hidden History", "body": "Dylan argues that the Sibyl story is routinely told as Greek history while Italy's own past, especially its Etruscan past, is covered over, and he announces a new book pressing that case. He suspects, while saying he cannot prove it, that the eruption that destroyed Pompeii crippled the region and opened the door to outside priests arriving under the guise of aid. In his prepared section on Justin Martyr he argues that the spelling used for Christians shows corruption, and that the whole system was kept by priests and mariners who knew its language."}, {"title": "Gabe Reads Between the Zebra Stripes", "body": "Gabe argues that Socrates is coded as a donkey, more specifically a zebra, a midwife who reads between the lines, and he ties the image to his own capoeira practice. He says meditating on the word Sibyl has taught him to break spells, and that the most grotesque images often guard the most valuable meaning. In his finale he reads Machiavelli's Golden Ass and its terza rima as a rhythmic code, suggesting the Sibyls believed they could plant programming that a rhythm or password would trigger in later lives, an idea the conversation ties to the doctrine of transmigration."}, {"title": "Law Books, Rituals and Plague", "body": "Chance presents the Laws of Manu, translated by Sir William Jones and used to build the Hindu law code for the East India Company, and argues that such creation stories are law books just like the Old Testament. His slide on the lectisternium, a Roman meal for the gods served on draped couches and said to come from the Sibylline books, leads the conversation to ask whether plague, from plaga, a wound or a strike, once meant war. A later slide follows the Argei straw figures thrown into the Tiber from the Pons Sublicius."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Oracles and Sybils no doubt played a crucial role in the ancient world, but just how foundational are their doctrines to our current ecclesiastical & civil systems? Along with Dylan Saccoccio and Slick Dissident, tune in for an exploration of the female illuminati and their priestly prophetesses.

Then what good work do they have?", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Once you know the language, you can see this system and it's very specific. And there's only one group of people that know this system and it's the priest and mariners.", "author": "Dylan Saccoccio", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0d1bec4c-36ec-4ba4-a1cb-9de0908b2433/Dylan-Saccoccio.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "I think that the Sibyls believed they were programming people in this life with overt programming that could be covertly triggered in future lives by simply hitting the tambourine or speaking in the same cadence or rhythm or even language or passwords to trigger like a sleeper cell in this life.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Look at this conversation in the last four and a half hours as a perfect example, how right when something is about to come up for a slide, it's already being brought up by the other ones.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The more I comprehend the language of the biofield, the more I map that out in my own mind, the more people's sessions start talking to me, very specific information.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
